stdout_matches: unsigned long long wrap\(int a0,unsigned int a1,int a2,int a3\)
unsigned long long hi\(int a0,unsigned int a1,int a2,int a3\)

notes: WHOLE (the default): an unproven wrapper of a proven callee returns the callee's whole value high word first, so wrap prints right and hi, whose source returns the high word, prints as the 64-bit value it hands back. viahook, proven by its caller, returns the pair a call through a function pointer left, joined high word first on both sides.
